snippet.title: Hired Blade | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Unwind in taverns to boost your squad's morale! Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!

Add  to your Steam Wishlist now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/
4285140/Hired_Blade/
